logline: Mart, a young graphic designer who has recently moved to Tartu for a job at a small studio

family: Sunday lunch at Mart's parents' farmhouse in Võrumaa
Liis's family birthday picnic in the Toomemägi park
Peeter showing old family photos in his kitchen
A video call with Mart's grandmother in Põlva
daily: Morning coffee at a café on Raekoja plats
An evening walk along the Emajõgi riverbank
Doing laundry and tidying the flat in Karlova
Waiting for the city bus at the Kesklinn stop by Kaubamaja
work: The design studio in Aparaaditehas on a Monday morning
A client meeting in a conference room at the Tartu Science Park (Sparkup)
Lunch break with colleagues at a café in Aparaaditehas
Printing posters at a print shop in the city center
offices: Registering an address at the city's population office on Küüni street
Opening an account at a bank office on Ülikooli street
Visiting the family doctor's practice in Annelinn
Picking up a parcel from an Omniva parcel machine
media: Reading the local news on Tartu Postimees online
Listening to a morning show on Vikerraadio
Watching the weather forecast on ERR
Scrolling through a city events page about the Tartu festivals
exam: The language exam center on Jakobi street
Filling in a form at the Tartu library
A short interview about daily life at a language school
Describing a picture of Raekoja plats to an examiner
curious: The Estonian National Museum (ERM) at Raadi
The leaning house on Raekoja plats, home of the Tartu Art Museum
The sauna at the Aura water center

cafe.title: Kohvikus
cafe.blurb: Order breakfast at a cozy café on the Town Hall Square.
cafe.brief: Kadri, the friendly owner of a small café on Raekoja plats in Tartu; it is morning and I come to the counter to order breakfast
cafe.task: Order a coffee and something to eat, and pay.

way.title: Tee küsimine
way.blurb: Ask a local how to get to the science center.
way.brief: a helpful local passerby on Raekoja plats in Tartu; I stop you to ask the way to Teaduskeskus AHHAA
way.task: Find out how to get to Teaduskeskus AHHAA and how long it takes.

colleague.title: Kolleegiga
colleague.blurb: Chat with a colleague on your lunch break.
colleague.brief: Tiina, a team lead at a design studio in Aparaaditehas, Tartu; it is lunch time and I am the new colleague you are chatting with at a café there
colleague.task: Introduce yourself, talk about your work and ask about the weekend.

shop.title: Turul
shop.blurb: Buy food at the market hall.
shop.brief: a seller at a vegetable and cheese stall in Tartu Turuhoone; I want to buy a few groceries
shop.task: Buy a few things, ask about prices, and pay.

doctor.title: Arsti juures
doctor.blurb: Visit the family doctor with a cold.
doctor.brief: a kind family doctor at a practice in Annelinn, Tartu; I have come in with a mild cold
doctor.task: Explain how you feel and understand the doctor's simple advice.

family.title: Pereõhtu
family.blurb: Have dinner with your neighbor's family.
family.brief: Liis's mother, hosting a relaxed family dinner in your flat in Karlova, Tartu; I am a guest at your table
family.task: Talk about your own family and answer questions about yourself.

station.title: Bussijaamas
station.blurb: Buy a bus ticket home for the weekend.
station.brief: a ticket clerk at Tartu bussijaam; I want to travel to Võru
station.task: Buy a ticket and find out the departure time and platform.

restaurant.title: Restoranis
restaurant.blurb: Have dinner out on a Friday night.
restaurant.brief: a waiter at a cozy restaurant in the old town near Raekoja plats in Tartu; I have just sat down
restaurant.task: Order a starter, a main course and a drink, and ask for the bill.

hotel.title: Hotellis
hotel.blurb: Check in for a weekend trip.
hotel.brief: the receptionist at a small hotel in Tartu old town near the Emajõgi; I have a booking
hotel.task: Check in, ask about breakfast time and get your room key.

cast.name: Mart Tamm
cast.role: The lead, a friendly graphic designer from a small village in Võrumaa, new to city life in Tartu

cast.name: Liis Kask
cast.role: Mart's neighbor across the hall, a cheerful biology student at the University of Tartu

cast.name: Tiina Saar
cast.role: Mart's colleague and team lead at the design studio, patient and good with deadlines

cast.name: Peeter Ilves
cast.role: Mart's landlord, a retired school teacher who loves gardening and local history

cast.name: Kadri Mets
cast.role: Owner of a small café near the Town Hall Square where Mart has breakfast

cast.name: Rasmus Kask
cast.role: Liis's curious eight-year-old brother, who lives with their mother in Karlova and asks endless questions

places.name: Raekoja plats
places.note: The Town Hall Square, where Mart meets friends and Kadri's café stands nearby

places.name: Aparaaditehas
places.note: The old factory turned creative quarter, home to Mart's design studio and its cafés

places.name: Toomemägi
places.note: The green hill with park paths where Mart walks, thinks, and chats with Peeter

places.name: Tartu Turuhoone
places.note: The indoor market where Mart buys bread, cheese, and vegetables

places.name: Teaduskeskus AHHAA
places.note: The science center where Mart and Liis take Rasmus on weekends

places.name: Tartu bussijaam
places.note: The bus station Mart uses to travel home to Võrumaa and around Estonia

beats.first-words: Mart arrives in Tartu, greets his landlord Peeter and meets Liis in the stairwell, trading names and hellos.
beats.who-i-am: At Kadri's café Mart says who he is, where he lives and what he does, and Kadri tells him about herself.
beats.no-and-questions: On his first day at the studio Mart asks Tiina many questions and learns what the office does not have.
beats.whose-is-it: Peeter shows Mart old family photos, and Mart explains whose brother, sister and grandmother is whose.
beats.having: Mart and Liis sort out the hallway: whose bikes and boxes are whose, and what Mart's flat has and still lacks.
beats.counting: At the Turuhoone market Mart buys bread, apples and cheese, counting money and amounts with the sellers.
beats.where-things-are: Mart unpacks his boxes, takes things out, puts them into cupboards and asks Peeter where everything goes.
beats.going-places: Mart crosses Tartu by bus, from the market to the riverbank and from the station back to work, asking the way.
beats.wants-and-plans: Mart, Liis and Rasmus plan a Saturday at AHHAA: what they want to see, what they must bring and when to go.
beats.with-friends: Mart has friends over for dinner and describes the food, the guests and the colorful table.
beats.do-it: Peeter teaches Mart to make jam in his kitchen, giving one instruction after another.
beats.yesterday: Over coffee Mart tells Kadri about his busy yesterday and what he did not manage to do.
beats.some-things: Mart shops for a housewarming party, buying some of everything and many small things.
beats.many-places: Liis shows Mart the town's parks, museums and cafés and tells him about the people in them.
beats.asking-nicely: On a weekend trip Mart checks into a small hotel and politely asks for what he would like.
beats.comparing: Mart and Liis compare Tartu with Tallinn and Mart's village: which is bigger, older, better.
beats.what-happened: Mart wakes up ill and tells the family doctor what has happened since Friday.
beats.becoming: As winter comes, Mart talks with Tiina about what he wanted to become, what he works as, and until when he will stay.
beats.how-it-is-done: Mart registers his address at the city government and learns how things are done and what is not allowed.
beats.busy-doing: On a busy Saturday everyone Mart calls is in the middle of something or just back from somewhere.
beats.linking-ideas: Mart explains to Rasmus who is who in the building, which flat is whose and why things are the way they are.
beats.around-and-away: Peeter sends Mart on an errand across the old town, under arches, behind churches and out to the river.
beats.they-say: Rumors fly around the café that a famous designer is coming to Tartu, and Mart passes on what people say.
beats.two-registers: Mart chats casually with friends at a sauna evening, then writes a formal email to the city for the studio.
